services.name: Current Exhibition
services.desc: In celebration of the American Semiquincentennial, Susan Sheehan Gallery is pleased to present Living in America: The Printed Image. While artists have long used printmaking to examine the nation’s cultural ethos, twentieth-century artists embraced Americana-the artifacts and cultural touchstones that characterize United States history and culture-to refine their interpretations. The exhibition features master prints by Vija Celmins, Edward Hopper, William Henry Johnson, Jasper Johns, Ed Ruscha, Andy Warhol, and H.C. Westermann. H.C. Westermann’s See America First is a fantastical, humorous, and sometimes unpleasant exploration of the artist’s complicated views of his country. As a World
